cohort: Clinical records of 46 Great Dane litters (comprising 303 puppies) from 8 different kennels were evaluated.
finding: Planned C-sections (PS) resulted in significantly lower stillbirth and neonatal mortality rates compared to vaginal delivery (VD) and emergency C-sections (ES), leading to the lowest observed perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Planned C-sections significantly reduced the risk of stillbirth and neonatal mortality compared to both vaginal deliveries and emergency C-sections.
